title: Spiking Neural Network Actor-Critic Proximal Policy Optimization Control for Autonomous UAV Navigation Through Constrained Openings in Civil Infrastructure and Buildings
abstract: arXiv:2609.23643v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Autonomous navigation of unmanned aerial vehicles in constrained three-dimensional environments has been a challenge in the robotics domain. The application of autonomous unmanned aerial vehicles in civil infrastructure inspection involves the use of such vehicles in bridge inspection, tunnel inspection, and structural inspection. The use of deep reinforcement learning in the autonomous navigation of unmanned aerial vehicles has been successful in constrained environments. However, the computational cost of the algorithm limits the application of the algorithm in the autonomous navigation of unmanned aerial vehicles. This paper proposes the use of the spiking neural network-based Proximal Policy Optimization algorithm in the autonomous navigation of unmanned aerial vehicles in constrained sequential environments. translated_title: 基于脉冲神经网络Actor-Critic近端策略优化的无人机自主导航控制：穿越民用基础设施与建筑物中的受限开口
translated_abstract: 无人机在受限三维环境中的自主导航一直是机器人领域的一项挑战。自主无人机在民用基础设施检测中的应用涉及桥梁检测、隧道检测和结构检测等场景。深度强化学习在受限环境下的无人机自主导航中已取得成功，然而该算法的计算成本限制了其在无人机自主导航中的实际应用。本文提出在受限序列环境中使用基于脉冲神经网络的近端策略优化（PPO）算法实现无人机自主导航。所提出的算法将基于脉冲的Actor-Critic强化学习与近端策略优化相结合。
tldr: 本文提出将基于脉冲神经网络的Actor-Critic强化学习与近端策略优化（PPO）相结合，在降低计算成本的同时，实现了无人机在民用基础设施与建筑物受限开口等三维受限环境中的自主导航。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a spiking neural network-based actor-critic Proximal Policy Optimization algorithm that reduces computational cost while enabling autonomous UAV navigation through constrained openings in civil infrastructure and buildings.
